effect: At the bottom of a bracket the GingerCraven clear comes down to whether its fear lands on the carries and how long it runs; clears at 35% finish with 0.6–1.8 s left.
mitigation: Dedicated deck (Scorpion poison to 20 stacks, Brightseeker kept on the boss), damage-reduction perks and pets, and retries; boss auto-summon lets auto retry unattended.

factor: Accuracy and focus below the stage's requirement
effect: Every attack below the accuracy requirement can miss (about 10% more misses per 100 short, per one poster) and debuffs below the focus requirement fail to land; at 15% and in the Rift a few misses decide the fight.
mitigation: Meet the stage's accuracy requirement (1,203.5 caps it from about chapter 248) or at least 900–1,000 after the easing; raise focus for debuffers.

effect: Pomegranate's beam and ATK-targeted perks go to the cookies with the highest ATK; if the wrong cookie holds top ATK the buffs miss the carry. Some pushers lower Skating Queen and Cherry Cola a step or two, or leave Pinot Noir at Lv.75, to steer them; ND러너 says to maximise power instead.
mitigation: Check the ATK order in battle; steer with sugar-rune ATK lines rather than levels when the bracket is tight.

effect: On auto, Cherry Cola runs ahead and drags Milk away, so Brightseeker loses Milk's buff; the same deck clears by hand.
mitigation: Drop Cherry Cola from auto decks unless Bari is in, or play the opening by hand.

effect: A Rift level either sheds 20–30% of the boss's HP in a try or doesn't move; the difference is mostly 차원의 힘 level, not luck.
mitigation: Give a level about five tries, then park in the Rift and let 차원의 힘 level up.
